freeze_gate: Every parameter has defensible conservative bounds from EXTERNAL DATA or PRE-STUDY CALIBRATION; otherwise FINAL_N_NOT_YET_FREEZABLE.

EMPIRICAL ISSUE-110 OUTCOME.rules: Prohibited before final sample-size freeze, including blinded or pooled endpoint-derived variance if it reveals study outcome information.

EXTERNAL DATA.rules: Published or archived data collected independently of Issue #110, provenance/hash/date recorded; task/outcome comparability justified without inspecting #110 outcomes.

PRE-STUDY CALIBRATION.rules: Instrumentation/environment dry runs on non-study tasks or aggregate operational metadata fixed before assignments; no candidate qualification, study task, condition contrast, acceptance, binding, or migration outcome.

SYNTHETIC ASSUMPTION.rules: Clearly fictional sensitivity values only; cannot alone freeze final N.
